contents_summary: Supplementary Table 2: a timeline table of the index infant by day of life (title, header row, 19 data rows from D0-7 to the 13-month visit, and a footnote with abbreviations), listing signs, laboratory and imaging findings, treatment interventions and responses. All 23 units were read.

limitations: Dash cells in the Key Laboratory & Imaging Findings column (D15, D29, D48, after 1 day) are recorded as missing entries with unknown status; dash and empty cells in the intervention and response columns carry no facts.
CSF cell count at D9 (23) differs from the main article text (105 on day 9); CSF NGS organisms conflict with the main text statement of negative microbiology; both are kept review-only.

Table day labels differ from the article text and Figure 4 for the canakinumab start (D48 in the table, 48 days of life in the text, d43 on the figure axis) only as separate sources; no reconciliation is made.
Catch-up growth at 13 months conflicts with the article statement of persistently delayed growth and is kept review-only.
